description:
Place the order: obtain the user's payment approval when needed, give you an approved wallet card to enter, and submit at the order control you name.

Supply the checkout reference and the control that places the order: its reference in `submit_ref`, or a description in `submit_look` when it has none. The call pays for the terms your latest `checkout.inspect` recorded, so inspect the checkout again when its terms change. When no approval covers the terms, it shows the user the payment approval with those terms and a capture of the page, and waits for their decision. Once the user approves, the same call goes on: it gives you the wallet card, enters the Shop Pay approval, or presses the order control on the view you named it on. When the page changed meanwhile, the press is refused; observe the page and call again. The runtime reuses an approval that still covers the checkout, as described in your checkout instructions. On a card checkout, the payment approval pays with the wallet card Muse chose. With `use_wallet` and no card chosen, it lists the user's wallet cards and the user picks one. Otherwise it pays with a card entered on the page, shown as the page's payment method. An approved wallet card comes back once, with its number, expiry, security code, name and billing address, and it stays yours for this purchase: enter it again if the card fields empty. On a card-entry page before the final order control, call with `submit_ref` and `submit_look` null to get it.

It refuses until Muse has confirmed the cart. Review material changes with Muse as described in your checkout instructions. A price change alone needs no second cart confirmation; the payment approval handles any higher amount. Ask for payment approval and press the order control only through this tool. When the result says payment details were applied, continue to the final order step and call again with its order control. A declined approval stays declined. Only the merchant's confirmation proves the order went through.

submit_ref.description: The reference of the control that places the order, or null to pay without placing it.

submit_look.description: The order control in words, as it appears on screen, when it has no reference: what it is, its visible text and where it sits. Null otherwise.

submit_within.description: With submit_look, an element reference to search inside; null otherwise.

use_wallet.description: True on a card checkout to pay with one of the user's wallet cards when checkout.inspect reports no card chosen and a wallet that can pay. The user picks the card in the payment approval. Null otherwise.
